title: 第13章 好一个真玄第14章 贡献点和师门任务
slug: 高武这个和尚太能装了
content_zh:
;;
“既然如此，那贫僧就不客气了。”
话音未落，他动了。
剑光一闪，如同一道银色的闪电，划破长空，直刺真玄的咽喉。
《剑禅七式》第一式，不立文字！
这一剑快到了极致，剑未到，剑意已经锁定了真玄的周身要害。
真玄面色不变，脚步微动，身体向左偏移了半寸。
就是这半寸，让明心志在必得的一剑落了空。
剑尖擦着真玄的咽喉掠过，带起一缕微风。
明心的瞳孔猛缩。
好快的身法！
他来不及多想，第二剑已经刺出。
第二式，教外别传！
这一剑比第一剑更快，更狠，更准。
剑光如同一条银蛇，在空中划出一道诡异的弧线，从真玄的左侧刺向他的右肋。
真玄脚步再动，身体向右偏移了半寸。
剑尖再次擦着他的僧袍掠过，还是差一点点。
明心的脸色变了。
如果说第一剑是巧合，那第二剑呢？
他咬紧牙关，第三剑、第四剑、第五剑接连刺出。

一剑比一剑快，一剑比一剑狠。
剑光在空中交织成一张银色的网，将真玄笼罩其中。
但真玄就像一条滑不留手的泥鳅，在剑光中穿梭，每一次都只差半寸，每一次都能险之又险地避开。
明心的额头沁出了汗珠。
他已经将《剑禅七式》的前五式尽数施展开来，但连真玄的衣角都没碰到。
这人到底是什么身法？
明心不知道的是，真玄使用的正是《渡厄踏风》。
这套身法真玄已经修炼到了登堂入室的境界，举手投足之间都合着天地韵律。
如果真玄一心躲闪，别说明心的剑，便是那以快见长的狂风刀法也未必能沾到他的衣角。
更何况，真玄是抱丹期的高手，对身体的掌控已经达到了入微的境界。
别说只差半寸，便是只差一根头发丝的距离，他也能从容避开。
明心深吸一口气，变招了。
第六式，直指人心！
这一剑与前五剑截然不同。
没有凌厉的剑光，没有尖锐的破空声，只有一道若有若无的剑意，如同一根无形的针，刺向真玄的心口。
这是《剑禅七式》中最诡异的一剑，不以伤人为目的，而是以剑意攻击对手的心神。
中者心神失守，轻则短暂失神，重则心神崩溃。
明心曾经用这一剑击败过很多化劲圆满的高手。
但他不知道的是，真玄的《真如观心掌》正好克制这种攻击心神的招式。

"In this case, the poor monk will not be polite."
Before he finished speaking, he moved.
The sword light flashed, like a silver lightning, piercing the sky and piercing Zhenxuan's throat.
The first form of "Seven Forms of Sword Zen" does not establish words!
This sword was almost at its peak, but before the sword reached it, the sword intent had already locked onto Zhenxuan's vital points.
Zhenxuan's expression remained unchanged, his steps moved slightly, and his body shifted half an inch to the left.
It was this half-inch that made Ming's determined sword fail.
The tip of the sword passed by Zhenxuan's throat, bringing with it a wisp of breeze.
Mingxin's pupils shrank sharply.
What a fast movement!
Before he could think too much, the second sword had already been thrust out.
The second form is taught to outsiders!
This sword is faster, harder and more accurate than the first sword.
The sword light was like a silver snake, drawing a strange arc in the air and piercing Zhenxuan's right rib from the left side.
Zhenxuan moved again, and his body moved half an inch to the right.
The tip of the sword brushed against his monk's robe again, still just a little bit close.
Mingxin's expression changed.
If the first sword was a coincidence, what about the second sword?
He gritted his teeth and stabbed out the third, fourth, and fifth swords one after another.
One sword is faster than the other, and one sword is harder than the other.
The sword light intertwined into a silver net in the air, shrouding Zhenxuan within it.
But Zhenxuan was like a slippery loach, shuttling through the sword light, missing it by only half an inch every time, and escaping it narrowly every time.
Beads of sweat broke out on Mingxin's forehead.
He had already deployed the first five moves of the "Seven Moves of Sword Zen", but he didn't even touch the corner of Zhenxuan's clothes.
What kind of physical skills does this person have?
What Mingxin didn't know was that Zhenxuan was using "Walk the Wind".
This body technique Zhenxuan has been practiced to the level of entering the palace and entering the house, and every move and every move is in harmony with the rhythm of heaven and earth.
If Zhenxuan concentrated on dodging, let alone Mingxin's sword, even the fast wind sword technique might not be able to touch the hem of his clothes.
What's more, Zhenxuan is a master in the Dan Bao stage, and his control over the body has reached a subtle level.
Let alone half an inch, even if it was only a hair away, he could easily avoid it.
Mingxin took a deep breath and changed her tactics.
The sixth form, points directly to the heart!
This sword is completely different from the previous five swords.
There was no sharp sword light, no sharp sound of breaking through the air, only a faint sword intention, like an invisible needle, piercing Zhenxuan's heart.
This is the strangest sword in the "Seven Styles of Sword Zen". It is not intended to hurt people, but to attack the opponent's mind with the sword's intention.
The victim's mind will lose control, ranging from a temporary loss of consciousness to a mental breakdown in severe cases.
Mingxin has used this sword to defeat many masters who have perfected their strength.
But what he didn't know was that Zhenxuan's "Zhen Ru Guan Xin Palm" happened to restrain this kind of attack on the mind.
